findings.F1: The book's gain is mostly eaten by fees. Gross gain averages 3.6e-05 per hour against 1.6e-05 of fees, so fees take about 45% of it, and this is what leaves the mean daily return at 0.00045, below the 0.0005 bar.
findings.F2: The loss sits in the weak forecasts. Bars with a forecast between 0 and 2 net -3.1e-05 per hour and bars between 2 and 5 net -3.2e-05, because their fees (2.1e-05 and 4.1e-05) exceed their gross gain (-1.0e-05 and 8.4e-06). Bars between 10 and 20 net +1.41e-04 per hour on a mean position of 0.84.
findings.F3: The follow-through is not proportional to the week's rise. On the trending 168-bar grid, the two lower 7-day-return quartiles return -0.011 to +0.017 (t between -1.06 and 1.25). The two upper quartiles return 0.024 to 0.039 (t 1.86 to 2.23). On the 24-hour grid, long bars in the two lowest 7-day quintiles earn 0.00003 and -0.00005 (t about 0.6), against 0.0029 to 0.0037 (t 3.5 to 4.0) in the top two.
findings.F4: The forecast level shows the same shape. On the 24-hour grid, long bars in the top forecast quintile (mean forecast 18.7) earn 0.0057 per day (t 4.8), while the quintile with mean forecast 4.3 earns 0.0006 (t 2.7) and the two lowest quintiles earn about 0.
findings.F5: Closeness to the 30-day high carries the gain, as the brief says. Long bars in the top quintile by distance to the 30-day high (mean 1.1% below it) earn 0.0034 per day (t 3.4). The quintile 4% below earns 0.0029 (t 4.3), the quintiles 8% and 14% below earn 0.0004 and 0.0010, and the quintile 30% below earns 0.0002.
findings.F6: The book's deepest fall, -35.5%, built up over windows 5 to 10, with drawdowns of -24% to -36%. In those windows the coins' 30-day return averaged 0.021 against 0.056 elsewhere, and their 90-day return 0.087 against 0.196, yet the book was long more often (58% of bars against 49%). The Calmar is 0.42.
findings.F7: The weakest month regime does not explain the fall. Long bars in the highest 30-day-return quintile (mean +66%) earn less, 0.0016 per day (t 1.8), than the middle quintile (+24%, 0.0031, t 4.0). Splitting the trending grid by the 90-day return's sign shows no difference: 0.0146 (n 81) against 0.0124 (n 209).

ideas.idea: While a coin's 30-day return is positive, the larger its 7-day return, the higher its return over the next 7 days, with the follow-through growing more than in proportion to the week's rise, so that it is concentrated after the largest weekly rises and almost absent after small ones.
ideas.consequence: In a rising month, a trader should commit size only after a coin's strongest weeks, and not pay fees to hold small positions after modest weekly gains that carry no follow-through.
ideas.name: follow-through after strongest weeks

ideas.idea: While a coin's 30-day return is positive, the larger its 7-day return, the higher its return over the next 7 days, and the more so the closer its close stands to its highest close of the last 30 days.
ideas.consequence: A rising week is worth buying mainly when it carries the coin up to its 30-day high, and much less when the coin is still far below that high.
ideas.name: weekly momentum near monthly high
